bibleget-tracking-category: Name of the tracking category for pages with failed Bible quotes.
bibleget-tracking-category-desc: Description of the tracking category [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for pages with failed Bible quotes.
bibleget-toolong-category: Name of the tracking category for pages with Bible quotes cut to the verse limit.
bibleget-toolong-category-desc: Description of the tracking category [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for pages with Bible quotes cut to the verse limit.
bibleget-error-network: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: no answer from the BibleGet API (network error or timeout).
bibleget-error-status: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API answered with an unexpected HTTP status.
bibleget-error-reference: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API reported an error for the reference.
bibleget-error-version: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API does not know the requested Bible version.
bibleget-error-ratelimit: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the user's rate limit or the BibleGet API's rate limit was reached.
bibleget-error-registration: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the wiki could not register with, or obtain a working credential from, the BibleGet API.
bibleget-error-clientkey-revoked: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the BibleGet API revoked the client key bundled with this release of the extension. A "project key" is an API key obtained from the BibleGet developer pages.
bibleget-error-noref: Error shown in place of a Bible quote when or {{#biblequote:}} is used without a reference.
bibleget-error-toomany: Reason shown in the tooltip of a failed Bible quote: the page already has the maximum number of distinct Bible quotes ($wgBibleGetMaxQuotesPerPage).
bibleget-note-cut:
Note shown at the end of a Bible quote that was cut to the verse limit.

Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of verses shown for one quote
bibleget-popup-close: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that closes a Bible quote popup.
right-bibleget-manage:
{{doc-right|bibleget-manage}}
The right to manage the BibleGet extension; holders also receive the BibleGet service notices.
bibleget-notice-banner-label: Label at the start of the banner that shows a BibleGet service notice to the wiki's BibleGet managers (when the Echo extension is not installed). Followed by the notice text.
bibleget-notice-link: Text of the link to more information about a BibleGet service notice, in the banner and in the Echo notification.
bibleget-notice-dismiss:
Label of the button that hides a BibleGet service notice banner for good.
{{Identical|Dismiss}}
bibleget-notice-deprecation:
Text of a BibleGet service notice that came only from the API's Deprecation HTTP header, without text of its own.

Parameters:
* $1 - the deprecation date, as YYYY-MM-DD
bibleget-notice-sunset:
Text of a BibleGet service notice that came only from the API's Sunset HTTP header, without text of its own.

Parameters:
* $1 - the sunset date, as YYYY-MM-DD
echo-category-title-bibleget: Name of the Echo notification category for BibleGet service notices, shown in [[Special:Preferences]].
echo-pref-tooltip-bibleget: Tooltip of the BibleGet notification category in [[Special:Preferences]].
